releaseNotes.0.1.1.0: Automatic component widths for full control-pin labels, plus 10-unit Container and Channel Group connectors with centered labels and pins. Restart Designer; no extra action is needed.
releaseNotes.0.1.2.0:
Q-SYS Mod Manager now enables Automatic Geometry by installing its module and disables it by removing that managed module. This version no longer needs a separate enable-marker file beside Designer. The exact Designer 10.5 build checks remain in place.

Use the manager's previewed update to migrate from an older package and remove its managed legacy marker. Restart Designer after installation.

The catalog listing now uses the supplied Avitex artwork. Its description, image and release notes are owned and published by this repository.

releaseNotes.0.1.0.0:
Better Packing

Pack schematic components and Layout items with exposed control-pin spacing, a saved gap, and optional replacement of native Pack commands.

Requires the approved Designer 10.5 build and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8 or later. Use the manager migration when replacing the legacy Schematic Tools bundle. Source and isolated-host validation are recorded in the repository README.

Better Shortcuts

Customize shortcuts for mod commands and native Designer commands, including dark mode, sidebars, programmer mode, and component controls.

Requires the approved Designer 10.5 build and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8 or later. Use the manager migration when replacing the legacy Schematic Tools bundle. Source and isolated-host validation are recorded in the repository README.

Clipboard Compatibility 0.1.0

Restores native component Copy All/Paste All using a bounded JSON clipboard transport on the exact inspected Designer 10.5.0 build. Requires Mods Core 0.1.5; Better Shortcuts is optional. Adds no shortcuts or preferences and preserves custom bindings.

Validated with 21 payload checks, 14 native transport/Harmony checks, and two Gains in disposable Designer Emulate using native commands and actual mouse input. Other component types and physical Core behavior remain untested.

This temporary compatibility mod is intended to be deprecated after QSC provides a verified native fix. Disable or remove it in Mod Manager with Designer closed, then restart and copy again. Historical package pins will be retained. Clipboard interoperability requires this mod in both participating Designer processes.

Color Palette Aligned

Align the Designer color palette into consistent rows.

Requires the approved Designer 10.5 build and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8 or later. Use the manager migration when replacing the legacy Schematic Tools bundle. Source and isolated-host validation are recorded in the repository README.

Command Palette 0.1.0

Open with Ctrl+Shift+P or Tools > Q-SYS Mods > Command Palette.
Search native and registered mod commands by name, category, source, or shortcut.
Use fuzzy abbreviations, arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Enter, Escape, or double-click.
See effective shortcuts, unavailable commands, and recent choices for this session.
Commands execute after restoring and rechecking the original editor context.

Requires Q-SYS Mods Core 0.1.4 and the exact supported Designer 10.5 build.
Main-window entry only; floating windows and embedded browser keyboard handling
are not accepted. Better Shortcuts is optional.

Install through Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8 or newer after refreshing its signed catalog.

Component Controls Info Filter

Filter Component Controls Info by control name and type.

Requires the approved Designer 10.5 build and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8 or later. Use the manager migration when replacing the legacy Schematic Tools bundle. Source and isolated-host validation are recorded in the repository README.

Icons Filter

Search the Designer icon picker with text and aliases.

Requires the approved Designer 10.5 build and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8 or later. Use the manager migration when replacing the legacy Schematic Tools bundle. Source and isolated-host validation are recorded in the repository README.

Q-SYS Mods Core

Shared Preferences, command registration, host compatibility checks, and theme integration for Q-SYS Designer mods.

Requires the approved Designer 10.5 build and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8 or later. Use the manager migration when replacing the legacy Schematic Tools bundle. Source and isolated-host validation are recorded in the repository README.
releaseNotes.0.1.5.0:
Q-SYS Mods Core 0.1.5

Core now owns native and mod command bindings, configurable two-stroke chords,
context guards, and effective shortcut labels without requiring Better Shortcuts.
Existing native keys and saved assignments take precedence over conflicting mod
defaults. Competing defaults remain unassigned, and intentional overwrite uses
the shared review/apply flow.

Includes grouped native-command replacements, retired-command alias migration,
and a live settings.json interface for supported Q-SYS General preferences and
mod settings. Changes are validated, conflicts remain visible, and last-good
recovery data is preserved. Unsupported or unknown settings are not silently
treated as writable native preferences.

The merged source passed automated contracts and the scoped Designer 10.5
acceptance documented in docs/SETTINGS-JSON.md and docs/MOD-CONTROLS.md. Physical
floating-window and recorder acceptance retains its documented limits.

Requires the exact supported Designer 10.5 binaries and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8+.
Update old Better Packing/Better Shortcuts builds to 0.1.1 or newer when used
together. Existing mod preferences and user assignments are retained.

releaseNotes.0.1.0.0:
Named Signal Colors

Preview and apply role-based colors to Named Signals, with a saved palette and an optional default-color filter.

Requires the approved Designer 10.5 build and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8 or later. Use the manager migration when replacing the legacy Schematic Tools bundle. Source and isolated-host validation are recorded in the repository README.
releaseNotes.0.1.1.0:
Named Signal Colors 0.1.1

Palette preferences now use the same color picker as Q-SYS Designer 10.5's signal-trace preferences, with a swatch, popup picker and exact color entry. Scroll to reach all 24 roles.

Existing opaque RGB palettes are preserved. OK saves the changes and refreshes an existing preview; Cancel discards the edits. Signal colors still change only when you explicitly apply a preview.

Requires the approved Designer 10.5 build, Q-SYS Mods Core 0.1.x and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8 or later. Close Designer before installing the update, then reopen it.
